{{Short description|Mathematical conjecture}}
In [[mathematics]], the '''Atiyah conjecture on configurations''' is a [[conjecture]] introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Atiyah|authorlink=Michael Atiyah|year1=2000|year2=2001}} stating that a certain [[square matrix|''n'' by ''n'']] [[matrix (mathematics)|matrix]]{{which|date=March 2022}} depending on ''n'' points in '''R'''<sup>3</sup> is always  [[non-singular matrix|non-singular]].
